exhibits.title: AI Research Museum
exhibits.body:
Explore landmark papers that shaped modern AI.
WASD to walk · Click portals to enter rooms.

exhibits.title: Attention Is All You Need
exhibits.body:
Vaswani et al., 2017 · Google Brain

The Transformer — self-attention only, no recurrence. Every major language model today descends from this architecture.

exhibits.title: BERT
exhibits.body:
Devlin et al., 2018 · Google AI

Bidirectional pre-training on masked language modeling. State-of-the-art across 11 NLP benchmarks upon release.

exhibits.title: GPT-3
exhibits.body:
Brown et al., 2020 · OpenAI

175B parameters. Few-shot learning across math, code, and translation — with zero gradient updates at inference.

exhibits.title: ResNet
exhibits.body:
He et al., 2015 · Microsoft Research

Skip connections made 100–1000 layer networks trainable. Won ILSVRC 2015 — 3.57% top-5 error, below human level.

exhibits.title: AlexNet
exhibits.body:
Krizhevsky et al., 2012

First deep CNN to win ImageNet. Cut top-5 error from 26% to 15.3% using ReLU, dropout, and GPU training.

exhibits.title: Transformer Architecture
exhibits.body: Multi-head attention allows the model to jointly attend to information from different representation subspaces at different positions.

exhibits.title: AlphaFold 2
exhibits.body:
Jumper et al., 2021 · DeepMind

Solved the 50-year protein folding problem using an Evoformer attention architecture trained on the Protein Data Bank.

exhibits.title: CLIP
exhibits.body:
Radford et al., 2021 · OpenAI

Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training on 400M pairs. Enables zero-shot image classification for any category.

exhibits.title: Latent Diffusion
exhibits.body:
Rombach et al., 2022

Diffusion in compressed latent space — orders of magnitude cheaper than pixel-space diffusion. The backbone of Stable Diffusion.

exhibits.title: NeRF
exhibits.body:
Mildenhall et al., 2020 · UC Berkeley

Neural Radiance Fields: a continuous 5D scene function. Photo-realistic novel view synthesis from sparse 2D images.

exhibits.title: RLHF
exhibits.body:
Christiano et al., 2017 · OpenAI

Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback. Trains a reward model on human comparisons — the core technique behind ChatGPT, Claude, and GPT-4.

exhibits.title: Scaling Laws
exhibits.body:
Kaplan et al., 2020 · OpenAI

Model performance scales as a power law with compute, data, and parameters — giving researchers a roadmap for frontier model development.
